# Veilus
> Anti-detect multi-account browser with built-in automation. Each profile gets its own fingerprint and proxy; your AI assistant writes and fixes automation scripts over MCP (or you write them), and Veilus runs them across profiles.

## Key Facts
- Free tier: 5 browser profiles forever, no credit card required
- 7-day Pro trial: request it in the app with your email; after 7 days you drop back to Free and keep your profiles
- Browser engine: Chromium built and patched in-house by Veilus
- Each profile has its own fingerprint and its own proxy (HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5)
- Built-in automation (Veilus Flow): an AI assistant with MCP support (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) writes Playwright scripts, runs them, reads per-profile errors and fixes them; you can also write scripts yourself and add them through the local REST API
- Scripts added over MCP or REST run on at most 3 profiles per run until the user approves them in the app; batch runs and schedules need that approval
- Profile data is stored locally on your machine; Veilus Sync is encrypted
- Platforms: macOS and Windows (no Linux version)

## Core Features
- Profiles: own fingerprint and own proxy per profile
- Veilus Flow: Playwright scripts written by your AI assistant over MCP or by you, run across many profiles
- MCP tools: list and launch profiles, save and read scripts, run a script on profiles, read per-profile run results
- Schedules and batch runs
- Local REST API and MCP for AI tools and developer automation
- Veilus Sync (encrypted), script templates, import/export

## Pricing
- Free: 5 profiles, 1 device, latest browser engine; no Veilus Flow, scheduling, batch runs or local API/MCP
- Monthly: 200,000 VND or $9 per device per month
- Lifetime (one-time): Solo 1 device 2,500,000 VND / $99; Team 5 5,000,000 VND / $199; Team 10 8,500,000 VND / $345; Team 20 16,000,000 VND / $650
- Paid plans: unlimited profiles, Veilus Flow, scheduling, batch runs, local REST API and MCP, Veilus Sync, script templates
- Lifetime includes updates forever and 3 years of support (renewal: 40% of the plan price per 3 years)
- More than 20 devices: contact us
- Refunds: within 7 days (monthly) or 14 days (lifetime)
- Buy: https://veilus.io/mua
